title: Hash Intelligence (PhotoDNA / VICS-ready)
description: Integrity and hash-matching profile. Cryptographic hashes live on ContentDataFacet; perceptual / PhotoDNA-style and VICS catalog matches are modeled as Tool + Action + AssessmentResult patterns ready for a first-class Facet later.
mission: Make every CSAM/hash-matching workflow produce queryable, court-defensible hash records without inventing new ontology terms.

File.notes: Populate Hash.hashMethod + Hash.hashValue for SHA-256 at minimum. Additional Hash entries carry MD5/SHA-1 when a lab still emits them.

RasterPicture.notes: PhotoDNA / PDNA / perceptual hashes are recorded as additional Hash objects (hashMethod vocabulary or typed literal) plus a ContentHashingTool InvestigativeAction. Do not invent PhotoDNAFacet in instance data.

recipe_skeleton.summary: Hashed media + hashing tool action + optional match/assessment result.
steps: Create ContentHashingTool (or Tool) with name/version (e.g. PhotoDNA, VICS catalog matcher).
Create EvidenceVerificationAction or InvestigativeAction with instrument=tool.
Create RasterPicture/File with FileFacet + ContentDataFacet hashes (crypto + perceptual).
If a catalog match exists, record AssessmentResult (CAC) or ConfidenceFacet; do not collapse match metadata into description JSON.
Link Relationship kind Derived_From / Selected_From as appropriate.
Validate with extensions=['cac'] when CAC classes are used.
